title: I built a browser daily word connection game and need feedback on the validation rules
author: No_Rock5928
selftext:
Yo, I built a daily word connection game called Daily Impossible Path and I’m looking for honest feedback

The idea is you get a start word and a target word, then try to connect them using as few bridge words as possible.



Example path:

( \[Start\] Sketchbook ) → artist → museum → gallery → ( \[ Target \] Literary Arts )



The hardest part has been deciding what should count as a valid connection. Some inputs are obvious, some are debatable, and some need a short explanation so the player understands why they were accepted or rejected.



Stack I used: Next.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind, Supabase/Postgres, Vercel, with a fallback validation system for unknown word pairs.



I’m especially interested in feedback on:

\- whether the rules feel clear

\- whether accepted connections feel fair

\- how strict or flexible the validation should be

\- whether the explanation text helps or gets in the way



Game:

[https://playimpossiblepath.com](https://playimpossiblepath.com)



Any feedback would help a lot.
